t: This is the home of the Clore Duffield Foundation, a registered charity. It was founded in 2000 when two older charities merged: the Clore Foundation, started by the financier and philanthropist Sir Charles Clore, and the Vivien Duffield Foundation, set up by his daughter. Dame Vivien Duffield is an English philanthropist, and she and her father are the two names behind the foundation. So the name you see here is really a family story, a father's charity joined with his daughter's.
